caption: Each bar is one checkpoint being written to stable storage. After P1 fails at t = 13 the only consistent set is the first checkpoint of every process, so the later checkpoints on all three lanes are discarded.

spec.aria: A timeline of six checkpoints on three processes; the first checkpoint of each process forms the recovery line, while the second checkpoints on P1, P2 and P3 are all abandoned after P1 crashes at t = 13.
